task: Add codemie-ui support for nested sub-assistant tool-call confirmation: nested waiting/decided steps at any depth, one-at-a-time decisions, thought_id on resume, reload restore, and 404/409 resume error handling without regressing single-assistant confirmation.

key_reasoning.reason: Base L: types (conversation, chatGeneration), chat generation store (_handleThought, resumeToolCall, _prepareRequestData, error path), BE-to-FE transform (chatHelpers), and UI (ChatAiMessage, ChatPrompt). Bumped to XL because the shared Thought/ThoughtHeader renderer is also consumed by the workflow execution state drawer, so the change reaches two workflows.

Closest pattern is the existing top-level tool-call confirmation and the recursive _findThought lookup, but a decided state, sequenced one-at-a-time decisions in one paused message, and status-aware resume errors have no precedent; api.stream drops the HTTP status so the 404/409 table must be keyed by message text; five top-level-only assumptions and the _finishThoughts orphan side effect make single-assistant regression a real risk. Base L, bumped to XL because the AC enumerates a 404/409 error table and depth/batch/reload variants while no existing test template covers resume error paths or nested trees.

About 8-9 modified source files (conversation.ts, types/chatGeneration.ts, store/chatGeneration.ts, chatHelpers.ts, ChatAiMessage.tsx, ChatPrompt.tsx, Thought.tsx, ThoughtHeader.tsx, possibly api.ts) plus updated and new tests (resumeToolCall, toolCallConfirmation, prepareRequestData, chatHelpers, a new ChatPrompt test) across 3+ directories.
UI, Service (Valtio store) and API client/request contract; no persistence or infrastructure. Backend contract is consumed, not changed.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from L to XL: touches the shared Thought renderer used by both chat and the workflow execution drawer (affects multiple workflows)
Technical Risk bumped from L to XL: acceptance criteria enumerate specific error rows (404/409 variants) and depth/batch/reload variants with no existing error-path or nested-tree test template
